verdict.summary: No blocking defect remains. The single authorized run completed four disposable AMP/SGD optimizer groups in an ABBA raw/cache order, two groups per path. All 64-sample input identities, heads, loss components, 195 unscaled gradient tensors, BN/model state, optimizer momentum, scaler state and post-step parameters were bit-exact across every trial. The monitored GPU window was 38.2957 seconds with a 50 C sampled peak and no thermal slowdown; the paused epoch-6 checkpoint remained byte-identical and no training checkpoint was written.

preflight_review.watchdog: An external base-Python process opens and retains a Windows handle to the exact benchmark process, signals ready before any CUDA call, applies a 295-second hard deadline, and terminates only that pinned process handle.
preflight_review.watchdog_failure_mode: After ready, any telemetry, stream, memory-query or other watchdog exception terminates the pinned benchmark process before attempting a failure receipt.
preflight_review.thermal_monitoring: Missing or ambiguous UUID/temperature/power/memory/thermal-slowdown telemetry fails closed. Active hardware or software thermal slowdown stops the benchmark. A bound-UUID final sample and explicit elapsed-time check are required before passed publication.
preflight_review.checkpoint_and_cache_gates: Exact checkpoint, checkpoint-protocol, checkpoint-training-manifest, road-manifest, cache-index, final cache-report and independent cache-review identities are checked before CUDA.
preflight_review.exclusive_output: Existing report or telemetry paths are rejected. The benchmark never opens the paused checkpoint for writing and rehashes it after the disposable run.
preflight_review.gradient_coverage: Each first/only group requires a gradient for every requires_grad named parameter; no missing-gradient parameter can be silently omitted from equality comparison.

independent_CPU_test.coverage: Telemetry identity/thermal guards, exact tree/input digest helpers, pinned-handle deadline termination, post-ready watchdog-exception termination and cache integrity regression.

equivalence_recalculation.same_epoch_and_shuffle: Mosaic epoch 6, generator seed 48, workers 0; each trial resets the same loader order and consumes the same 64 development samples.
equivalence_recalculation.interpretation: The raw and cache paths produced the same disposable one-step training transition from the same checkpoint, optimizer, scaler and RNG state. This proves the compared cache input path did not change this bounded AMP/SGD transition; it does not prove a multi-step or full-epoch trajectory.

timing_recalculation.timed_work_definition: Per-group fetch plus synchronized host-to-device transfer, AMP forward/backward, unscale, gradient clipping and SGD step. Diagnostic digest/snapshot/equality work is excluded.
timing_recalculation.boundary: There are only two observations per path. The first raw trial contains the first CUDA execution, raw/cache trials are not randomized, and workers=0 differs from the planned workers=4 training configuration. The 3.574x ratio is a bounded observation, not a steady-state, epoch, or formal-training speedup.

findings.evidence: Raw work observations were 15.8635 and 11.6593 seconds; cache observations were 3.9859 and 3.7149 seconds. The first raw compute was also the coldest CUDA execution.
findings.disposition: Retain the 3.574x value only as a bounded workers-0 observation. Do not extrapolate it to a full epoch, workers 4, 300 epochs, accuracy, or wall-clock completion.

findings.evidence: Manifest validation took 405.69 seconds and the benchmark's single train-cache constructor took 42.72 seconds before CUDA. The real trainer constructs both train and val cached datasets, while this benchmark constructed only train.
findings.disposition: Include full startup hashing, both split constructors, worker RAM/order and end-to-end epoch timing in any future adoption decision. The measured per-group cache benefit does not erase startup cost automatically.

findings.evidence: Every trial resets to the same epoch-6 checkpoint and performs one optimizer group. Exact final states therefore prove one-step equivalence repeated twice per path, not continuity across several consecutive cached steps.
findings.disposition: Do not call this a resumed training trajectory. Any later formal continuation still requires explicit user authorization and a reversible cache switch.

findings.evidence: The benchmark uses the pinned road train/val development manifest and consumes no newtest or blind image. Its checkpoint was trained on the separately pinned COCO manifest.
findings.disposition: This result is input-pipeline equivalence and bounded timing evidence only, not road accuracy or acceptance evidence.
